top_fixes.what_is_wrong: The BlogPosting author is a Person named 'Example Booking Software' (a company, not a person), the block has no image although every post shows a hero image, and the publisher repeats the Organization instead of pointing to its @id.
top_fixes.evidence: Page source on https://www.example.com/blog/appointment-reminder-templates/ and the crawler on https://www.example.com/blog/reduce-no-shows/: both posts carry the same BlogPosting from the blog template.
top_fixes.who: paste into the blog post template (replaces the current BlogPosting block). The byline reads 'the Example Booking Software team', so the author is the Organization; if a named person wrote a post, use a Person with that name instead.

top_fixes.what_is_wrong: The breadcrumb's second level has no name, so Google reports the Breadcrumbs item with an error and shows no trail.
top_fixes.evidence: URL Inspection on https://www.example.com/features/online-booking/: Breadcrumbs detected with 1 error (Missing field "name", item 2), last crawl 2026-10-19; the crawler shows the same block.
top_fixes.who: paste into the feature page template (replaces the current BreadcrumbList; the name comes from the breadcrumb shown on the page)

top_fixes.what_is_wrong: No BreadcrumbList, so the industry pages show no breadcrumb trail in results, unlike the pricing, feature, blog and template pages.
top_fixes.evidence: URL Inspection on https://www.example.com/industries/salons/: no rich results detected (last crawl 2026-10-21); the crawler finds Organization, WebSite, WebPage.
top_fixes.who: paste into the industry page template; on each page the last name is that page's own breadcrumb label

top_fixes.what_is_wrong: The VideoObject earns the video result but has no duration, a field Google recommends; the length shows on the player as 3:12.
top_fixes.evidence: URL Inspection on https://www.example.com/blog/reduce-no-shows/: Videos detected, 1 warning (Missing field "duration"), last crawl 2026-10-23. Search appearance VIDEO on this page: 1300 impressions.

not_worth_doing.item: Expecting FAQ rich results from the FAQPage blocks on https://www.example.com/ and https://www.example.com/templates/cancellation-policy/
not_worth_doing.reason: Google retired the FAQ rich result for every site from May 7, 2026. The blocks are harmless while the questions stay visible on the page, but they earn no rich result in Google.

not_worth_doing.item: Expecting a HowTo rich result from the HowTo block on https://www.example.com/blog/appointment-reminder-templates/
not_worth_doing.reason: HowTo is not in Google's current rich result list, so it would earn nothing in Google.

not_worth_doing.item: Merchant listings markup (Product with an Offer per item)
not_worth_doing.reason: The site sells monthly plans, not items a visitor buys from a product page, so a merchant listing doesn't fit; the SoftwareApplication offer already earns product snippets on the pricing page.
